description: Update a product from a JSON body. General settings only. Backlink settings belong to products_backlinks_update.

body.description: Request body as a JSON object. Fields (at least one, others are rejected): name, description, target_audiences (3-7, replaces the list), sitemap_url (.xml), blog_root_url, example_article_urls (max 3), auto_keyword_generation_disabled.

target_audiences.description: 3-7 audience texts of at most 200 characters each; replaces the list.
